tool.name: ML4M
tool.command:
python '$__tool_directory__/ml4m_tool.py'
## ── Input Files ── --dataMatrix "$dataMatrix" --sampleMeta "$sampleMeta" --varMeta "$varMeta" --responseCol "$responseCol" --sampleOut "$sampleOut" --reportOut "$reportOut" --metricsOut "$metricsOut" --coefficientsOut "$coefficientsOut"
## ── visualization ────────────────────────── --visualizationOut "$visualizationOut"
## ── ML Parameters ────────────────────────── --nRepeats "$nRepeats" --taskType "$taskTypeCond.taskType" --modelType "$taskTypeCond.modelTypeCond.modelType"
#if $taskTypeCond.modelTypeCond.modelType == "linear" or $taskTypeCond.modelTypeCond.modelType == "logistic"
#set $reg = $taskTypeCond.modelTypeCond.regularizationCond #set $regularization = $reg.regularization
--regularization "$regularization"
#if $regularization == "none" --paramMode "default" --alphaMode "manual" #else --paramMode "advanced" --alphaMode "automatic" --cvFolds "$reg.cvFolds" #end if
#else
--paramMode "default" --regularization "none" --alphaMode "manual" --cvFolds "$taskTypeCond.modelTypeCond.cvFolds"
#end if
## ── Partitioning Mode ── --partitionMode "$pModeCond.partitionMode"
#if $pModeCond.partitionMode == "auto" ## ── Step 1: Selection Mode ── --selectionMode "$pModeCond.selectionModeCond.selectionMode"
#if $pModeCond.selectionModeCond.selectionMode == "selected" --selectedSamples "$pModeCond.selectionModeCond.selectedSamples" --selectedRole "$pModeCond.selectionModeCond.selectedRoleCond.selectedRole" #end if
## ── Step 2 & 3 Logic ── ## We define a helper for the current "active" node to simplify the code #set $node = $pModeCond.selectionModeCond #if $node.selectionMode == "selected" #if $node.selectedRoleCond.selectedRole == "split_set" #set $active_split = $node.selectedRoleCond #else #set $active_split = None #end if #else #set $active_split = $node #end if
#if $active_split ## Step 2: Super Test --superTestMode "$active_split.superTestCond.superTestMode" #if $active_split.superTestCond.superTestMode == "manual" --superTestSamples "$active_split.superTestCond.superTestSamples" #elif $active_split.superTestCond.superTestMode == "stratified" --superTestSize "$active_split.superTestCond.superTestSize" #end if
## Step 3: Split Method #set $method_cond = $active_split.splitMethodCond --splitMethod "$method_cond.splitMethod"
#if $method_cond.splitMethod in ["holdout", "holdout_strat"] --testSize "$method_cond.testSize" #elif $method_cond.splitMethod in ["kfold", "kfold_strat"] --nSplits "$method_cond.nSplits" #end if
## Step 4: Advanced Params (Hidden for LOOCV) #if $method_cond.splitMethod != "loo" --advMode "$method_cond.advCpt.opcC" #if $method_cond.advCpt.opcC == "full" --shuffle "$method_cond.advCpt.shuffle" --seedList "$method_cond.advCpt.seedList" #end if #else --advMode "default" #end if #else ## Case: selected samples with role 'test' (fixed set) --superTestMode "none" --splitMethod "NONE" #end if #end if
tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**ML4M Data Partitioning**
This tool allows partitioning a dataset into training, test, and optionally external validation sets, for the purpose of machine learning analysis.
----------- Input files -----------
+---------------------------+------------+ | Fichier | Format | +===========================+============+ | 1) Data Matrix | tabular | +---------------------------+------------+ | 2) Sample Metadata | tabular | +---------------------------+------------+ | 3) Variable Metadata | tabular | +---------------------------+------------+
---------- Parameters ----------
**Partitioning Mode** - *Manual*: the "partition" column of sampleMeta is used directly. The allowed values are "train", "test", "super_test". - *Automatic*: the partition is calculated according to the parameters below.
**Step 1 — Working Set** - *All samples*: the entire universe is used as the split pool. - *Manual selection*: enter the IDs separated by commas (e.g., S1,S2,S3). Then choose their role: split pool or fixed test set.
**Step 2 — External validation** - *None*: no reservation. - *Manual*: enter the IDs of the samples to reserve. - *Stratified automatic* : indicate the proportion to reserve.
**Step 3 — Split Method** - *Holdout*: simple train/test split. - *Stratified holdout*: train/test split respecting the distribution of the response. - *K-Fold*: K-fold cross-validation. - *Stratified K-Fold*: cross-validation respecting the distribution of the response. - *LOOCV*: Leave-One-Out. Each sample serves as a test once. class:: warningmark Attention: very slow on large datasets ( > 100 samples).
**Step 4 — Machine Learning Method**
------------ Output files ------------
**Advanced Settings** - *Use default*: ``shuffle=True`` and a seed per target is derived automatically. - *Full parameter list*: allows you to choose ``shuffle`` and a ``seedList``.
sampleOut.tabular Enriched metadata file with a column ``split_[phenotype]`` indicating for each sample its role: ``train``, ``test``, ``super_test`` or ``excluded``.
sampleOut_parameter.tabular Traceability table containing the target column and the parameters used.
